instruction: Befriend on Venmo anyone I have sent or received money from this month.
notes: Single-app Venmo task. The set of people the supervisor exchanged money with this month is only known at runtime; the model uses two placeholder counterparties (declared as domain constants so supervisor-complete-task can require each to be befriended), one add_friend per distinct counterparty. At runtime add one person/email object and one goal literal per distinct non-friend counterparty found in show_transactions (min_created_at = 2023-05-01T00:00:00; paginate with page_index if needed). Counterparties who are already friends must be skipped (add_friend would fail / no new Friendship record). Since conditional effects are disallowed, discovery is modeled by the (transactions-listed) gate plus static (email-of ...) facts rather than per-person known-email effects. Only venmo.Friendship records may change; no answer is passed to complete_task.
